name: Reconstruction Agent
description: Reconstructs incomplete genomes or missing biological information. Covers filling in fragmented, partial or missing sequence data; reconstructing the genome of an extinct or poorly sequenced species; and inferring biological information that no database holds directly. Used when retrieval has already failed or the data is known to be incomplete - not as a first stop for data that can simply be looked up. Works on a specific sequence: the user must paste the nucleotide sequence containing the gaps, or name the accession of the record to repair. It does not pick a target sequence on its own, and unlike other agents it cannot request one from elsewhere. So do NOT choose this agent when the message names only a species and carries no pasted sequence and no accession - 'fill the gaps in the polar bear genome' included. Start with the Genome Agent for those: it resolves the species to a specific gapped scaffold and hands off to this agent automatically. Choose this agent only when the message itself already contains the sequence or the accession to repair.
